pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.

2. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.

3. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.

4. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

5. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.

6. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

10. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. Only one word repeated

11. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

12. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. quickly

13. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. goes
   D. went

14. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.

15. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text reading and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Language structures School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
